title: Is it an HPC Workflow Assistant? Is it a Framework? It's Drona Workflow Engine
problem: HPC resources increasingly complex; novice researchers face steep learning curve due to lack of HPC skills; inefficient resource utilization
motivation: Democratizing HPC access by reducing learning curve and automating workflow execution for non-expert researchers across diverse domains
method: Drona provides a graphical interface where researchers describe HPC (high-performance computing) workflows by clicking through options, automatically generating the underlying scripts. Before execution, users see an editable preview of the generated script and can modify it directly. This combines the ease of a point-and-click tool with the control of hand-written code. The system can import, create, and share workflows, making them reusable across projects.
key_novelty: It generates HPC (high-performance computing) scripts through a graphical interface but displays them in an editable preview, combining automated assistance with full manual control.
contributions: User-friendly GUI for scientific workflow specification
Framework for custom workflow creation and sharing
limitations: Abstract does not provide quantitative performance metrics or user study results
